before.en: For capability and expression, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 33.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Jian Lu / Yue Jie path and Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
before.zh: 就「能力与表达」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 33.3%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到建禄／月劫路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

after.en: For capability and expression, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 33.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth and Peer. Month-command candidates considered separately: Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading. Cross-group influences: Seven Killings, Indirect Resource, and Hurting Officer; these are not members of the leading group.
after.zh: 就「能力与表达」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 33.3%），主要连接到劫财、比肩。月令候选另列：伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。跨组影响另列：七杀、偏印、伤官；它们不是领先功能组的组内成员。

after.en: Core Personality reads the recurring way the chart receives information, develops capability, expresses itself and meets expectations. In BaZi, personality is not one isolated trait. It emerges from the relationship between the Day Master, the Ten Gods and the conditions that support or constrain how those functions are used.
after.zh: 核心性格读取的不是一个孤立标签，而是命盘如何吸收信息、发展能力、表达自己，以及面对期待时反复出现的运作方式。在八字里，性格来自日主、十神与支持或限制这些功能的条件之间的关系。

after.en: Core style comes from the relationship between the leading capability function and the other functions that remain active around it, not from one personality label.
after.zh: 核心运作方式来自首要能力功能与周围其他功能的关系，而不是一个性格标签。

after.en: Learning, absorption and expression are different layers of capability. A skill may be available internally while still needing different conditions to become consistent output.
after.zh: 学习、吸收与表达是能力的不同层次。一项能力可以已经存在，但仍需要不同条件才能成为稳定输出。

before.en: For life operation, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 33.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Jian Lu / Yue Jie path and Wealth pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
before.zh: 就「生活运行」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 33.3%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到建禄／月劫路径、财格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

after.en: For life operation, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 33.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth and Peer. It directly reconnects to 4 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading. Cross-group influences: Seven Killings, Indirect Resource, and Indirect Wealth; these are not members of the leading group.
after.zh: 就「生活运行」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 33.3%），主要连接到劫财、比肩。月令候选另列：财格路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 4 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。跨组影响另列：七杀、偏印、偏财；它们不是领先功能组的组内成员。

after.en: Life Structure brings the chart’s main mechanics into one view. It considers the carrying conditions of the Day Master, the functional balance of the Ten Gods, candidate pattern paths and the relationships between pillars. The purpose is to understand how the chart organizes support, demand and direction before applying it to specific life domains.
after.zh: 人生格局把命盘最主要的运作机制放到同一张图里阅读：日主的承载条件、十神功能的分布、可能形成的格局路径，以及柱位之间的关系。先理解命盘如何组织支持、负荷与方向，再把这些结构带入具体人生领域。

after.en: Day Master carrying conditions describe how much support and counter-pressure the reference point is working with. They are the base layer for later interpretation, not a judgment of personal worth.
after.zh: 日主承载条件说明这个参照点同时面对多少支持与反向负荷。它是后续解读的基础层，不是对个人价值的评价。

after.en: Pattern paths show how several functions may organize into a larger structure. A visible path is meaningful, but it remains different from a fully established pattern when conditions are still open.
after.zh: 格局路径显示多个功能可能怎样组织成更大的结构。路径可见本身有意义，但只要关键条件仍开放，就必须与“已经成格”区分。

before.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 20%, carried mainly by Seven Killings, Indirect Resource, and Indirect Wealth. It also connects to Wealth pattern path and Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
before.zh: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 20%），主要连接到七杀、偏印、偏财。同时可连接到财格路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

after.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 20%, carried mainly by Seven Killings. Month-command candidates considered separately: Wealth pattern path and Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading. Cross-group influences: Indirect Resource, Indirect Wealth, and Hurting Officer; these are not members of the leading group.
after.zh: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 20%），主要连接到七杀。月令候选另列：财格路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。跨组影响另列：偏印、偏财、伤官；它们不是领先功能组的组内成员。

after.en: Career Development reads how the chart handles responsibility, output, standards, resources and role boundaries. Rather than assigning a single “best profession,” this chapter looks at the kinds of working conditions in which the chart’s functions can be used coherently and sustained over time.
after.zh: 事业发展读取的是命盘如何处理责任、产出、标准、资源与角色边界。本章不会把你指定到某一个“最佳职业”，而是观察什么样的工作条件，能让命盘中的功能更连贯、更持续地被使用。

after.en: Career fit depends more on role structure than on job title: responsibility, autonomy, standards, resources and support need to be read together.
after.zh: 事业适配更取决于角色结构，而不是职位名称：责任、自主权、标准、资源与支持需要一起阅读。

after.en: The same capability can operate very differently under different working conditions. Authority, workload and clarity of expectations materially change how the structure is carried.
after.zh: 同一套能力在不同工作条件下可以表现得很不一样。权限、工作量与期待是否清楚，会明显改变结构如何被承载。

before.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 13.3%, carried mainly by Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer. It also connects to Wealth pattern path and Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
before.zh: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 13.3%），主要连接到劫财、七杀、比肩。同时可连接到财格路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

after.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 13.3%, carried mainly by Hurting Officer and Eating God. Month-command candidates considered separately: Wealth pattern path and Hurting Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ environment. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading. Cross-group influences: Rob Wealth, Seven Killings, and Peer; these are not members of the leading group.
after.zh: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 13.3%），主要连接到伤官、食神。月令候选另列：财格路径、伤官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 月令环境等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。跨组影响另列：劫财、七杀、比肩；它们不是领先功能组的组内成员。

after.en: Wealth Outlook reads the chart’s relationship with resources: how value is produced, exchanged, directed, maintained and placed under responsibility. In BaZi, “wealth” is first a structural function. Actual income, assets and financial outcomes still depend on real-world decisions and conditions outside the chart.
after.zh: 财富运势读取的是命盘与资源之间的关系：价值如何被创造、交换、调动、维持，以及怎样进入责任结构。在八字里，“财”首先是一种结构功能；真实收入、资产与财务结果仍取决于命盘之外的现实决定与条件。

after.en: Wealth is read as a resource cycle: how value enters, what must be exchanged for it and what competing demands act on it afterward.
after.zh: 财富要按资源循环来读：价值如何进入、需要交换什么，以及之后有哪些要求会分流资源。

after.en: Resource opportunity and resource retention are different structural questions. Receiving more does not automatically mean keeping more.
after.zh: 资源机会与资源留存是两个不同问题。得到更多，并不自动等于能够留下更多。

It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.

after.en: Relationships & Marriage reads how the chart approaches closeness, reciprocity, expectations, responsibility and personal position within important bonds over time. It does not reduce another person to a symbol; instead, it examines the recurring relational functions carried by this chart.
after.zh: 感情婚姻读取的是命盘在重要关系中如何处理亲近、互惠、期待、责任，以及自己的位置。它不会把另一个人压缩成一个符号，而是观察这张命盘反复携带怎样的关系功能。

after.en: Relationship reading begins with your recurring position: expectations, exchange, support, responsibility and boundaries need to be read together.
after.zh: 关系读取先看你反复出现的位置：期待、交换、支持、责任与边界需要一起理解。

after.en: Recorded links and tensions show where interaction may require negotiation. They describe relational structure, not the other person’s hidden motives.
after.zh: 已记录的联结与张力显示哪些互动需要协商；它们描述关系结构，不代表对方的隐藏动机。

after.en: Health & Wellbeing translates the chart’s load, rhythm and support structure into a non-clinical view of daily functioning. It focuses on how pressure, recovery and routine are organized. It does not diagnose disease, identify vulnerable organs or replace medical assessment.
after.zh: 健康养生把命盘中的负荷、节奏与支持结构，转换成对日常运作的非临床观察。重点是压力、恢复与生活规律怎样被组织；本章不诊断疾病、不判断器官弱点，也不能代替医疗评估。

after.en: Pressure is a structural theme before it is a health theme. It may describe demand, accountability or sustained load without implying illness.
after.zh: 压力首先是结构主题，其次才是生活观察主题。它可以代表要求、责任或持续负荷，但不等于疾病。

after.en: Recovery conditions matter as much as demand. Sleep, routine, workload, environment and practical support belong to real-life wellbeing evidence and should remain visible.
after.zh: 恢复条件与负荷同样重要。睡眠、作息、工作量、环境与实际支持，都属于真实生活中的身心证据，需要被保留下来。

after.en: Pattern paths show how several functions may organize into a larger structure. A visible path is meaningful, but it remains different from a fully established pattern when conditions are still open.
after.zh: 格局路径显示多个功能可能怎样组织成更大的结构。路径可见本身有意义，但只要关键条件仍开放，就必须与“已经成格”区分。

before.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 30%, carried mainly by Direct Officer, Direct Resource, and Indirect Wealth. It also connects to Direct Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ self anchor and OUTER_EXPRESSION_INTERFACE. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
before.zh: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 30%），主要连接到正官、正印、偏财。同时可连接到正官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 自我锚点、OUTER_EXPRESSION_INTERFACE等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

after.en: For career and work, the leading functional group is rules, responsibility and pressure at about 30%, carried mainly by Direct Officer and Seven Killings. Month-command candidates considered separately: Direct Officer pattern path and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ self anchor and year-hour context and expression interface. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading. Cross-group influences: Direct Resource, Indirect Wealth, and Indirect Resource; these are not members of the leading group.
after.zh: 就「事业与工作」而言，在这个主题里，「规则、责任与压力」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 30%），主要连接到正官、七杀。月令候选另列：正官格路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 自我锚点、年柱与时柱的背景与表达接口等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。跨组影响另列：正印、偏财、偏印；它们不是领先功能组的组内成员。

after.en: Career Development reads how the chart handles responsibility, output, standards, resources and role boundaries. Rather than assigning a single “best profession,” this chapter looks at the kinds of working conditions in which the chart’s functions can be used coherently and sustained over time.
after.zh: 事业发展读取的是命盘如何处理责任、产出、标准、资源与角色边界。本章不会把你指定到某一个“最佳职业”，而是观察什么样的工作条件，能让命盘中的功能更连贯、更持续地被使用。

after.en: Career fit depends more on role structure than on job title: responsibility, autonomy, standards, resources and support need to be read together.
after.zh: 事业适配更取决于角色结构，而不是职位名称：责任、自主权、标准、资源与支持需要一起阅读。

after.en: The same capability can operate very differently under different working conditions. Authority, workload and clarity of expectations materially change how the structure is carried.
after.zh: 同一套能力在不同工作条件下可以表现得很不一样。权限、工作量与期待是否清楚，会明显改变结构如何被承载。

before.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 10%, carried mainly by Direct Officer, Peer, and Rob Wealth. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by interfaces such as outer context ↔ self anchor and OUTER_EXPRESSION_INTERFACE. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
before.zh: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 10%），主要连接到正官、比肩、劫财。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 自我锚点、OUTER_EXPRESSION_INTERFACE等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

after.en: For wealth and resources, the leading functional group is expression and output at about 10%, carried mainly by Hurting Officer. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading. Cross-group influences: Direct Officer, Peer, and Rob Wealth; these are not members of the leading group.
after.zh: 就「财富与资源」而言，在这个主题里，「表达与输出」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 10%），主要连接到伤官。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径，并经过外部背景 ↔ 自我锚点、年柱与时柱的背景与表达接口等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。跨组影响另列：正官、比肩、劫财；它们不是领先功能组的组内成员。

after.en: Wealth Outlook reads the chart’s relationship with resources: how value is produced, exchanged, directed, maintained and placed under responsibility. In BaZi, “wealth” is first a structural function. Actual income, assets and financial outcomes still depend on real-world decisions and conditions outside the chart.
after.zh: 财富运势读取的是命盘与资源之间的关系：价值如何被创造、交换、调动、维持，以及怎样进入责任结构。在八字里，“财”首先是一种结构功能；真实收入、资产与财务结果仍取决于命盘之外的现实决定与条件。

after.en: Wealth is read as a resource cycle: how value enters, what must be exchanged for it and what competing demands act on it afterward.
after.zh: 财富要按资源循环来读：价值如何进入、需要交换什么，以及之后有哪些要求会分流资源。

after.en: Resource opportunity and resource retention are different structural questions. Receiving more does not automatically mean keeping more.
after.zh: 资源机会与资源留存是两个不同问题。得到更多，并不自动等于能够留下更多。

after.en: Relationships & Marriage reads how the chart approaches closeness, reciprocity, expectations, responsibility and personal position within important bonds over time. It does not reduce another person to a symbol; instead, it examines the recurring relational functions carried by this chart.
after.zh: 感情婚姻读取的是命盘在重要关系中如何处理亲近、互惠、期待、责任，以及自己的位置。它不会把另一个人压缩成一个符号，而是观察这张命盘反复携带怎样的关系功能。

after.en: Relationship reading begins with your recurring position: expectations, exchange, support, responsibility and boundaries need to be read together.
after.zh: 关系读取先看你反复出现的位置：期待、交换、支持、责任与边界需要一起理解。

after.en: Recorded links and tensions show where interaction may require negotiation. They describe relational structure, not the other person’s hidden motives.
after.zh: 已记录的联结与张力显示哪些互动需要协商；它们描述关系结构，不代表对方的隐藏动机。

after.en: Health & Wellbeing translates the chart’s load, rhythm and support structure into a non-clinical view of daily functioning. It focuses on how pressure, recovery and routine are organized. It does not diagnose disease, identify vulnerable organs or replace medical assessment.
after.zh: 健康养生把命盘中的负荷、节奏与支持结构，转换成对日常运作的非临床观察。重点是压力、恢复与生活规律怎样被组织；本章不诊断疾病、不判断器官弱点，也不能代替医疗评估。

after.en: Pressure is a structural theme before it is a health theme. It may describe demand, accountability or sustained load without implying illness.
after.zh: 压力首先是结构主题，其次才是生活观察主题。它可以代表要求、责任或持续负荷，但不等于疾病。

after.en: Recovery conditions matter as much as demand. Sleep, routine, workload, environment and practical support belong to real-life wellbeing evidence and should remain visible.
after.zh: 恢复条件与负荷同样重要。睡眠、作息、工作量、环境与实际支持，都属于真实生活中的身心证据，需要被保留下来。

before.en: For capability and expression, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 45.5%, carried mainly by Peer, Direct Officer, and Rob Wealth. It also connects to Jian Lu / Yue Jie path and is modified by interfaces such as environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 3 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
before.zh: 就「能力与表达」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 45.5%），主要连接到比肩、正官、劫财。同时可连接到建禄／月劫路径，并经过月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 3 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

after.en: Core Personality reads the recurring way the chart receives information, develops capability, expresses itself and meets expectations. In BaZi, personality is not one isolated trait. It emerges from the relationship between the Day Master, the Ten Gods and the conditions that support or constrain how those functions are used.
after.zh: 核心性格读取的不是一个孤立标签，而是命盘如何吸收信息、发展能力、表达自己，以及面对期待时反复出现的运作方式。在八字里，性格来自日主、十神与支持或限制这些功能的条件之间的关系。

after.en: Core style comes from the relationship between the leading capability function and the other functions that remain active around it, not from one personality label.
after.zh: 核心运作方式来自首要能力功能与周围其他功能的关系，而不是一个性格标签。

after.en: Learning, absorption and expression are different layers of capability. A skill may be available internally while still needing different conditions to become consistent output.
after.zh: 学习、吸收与表达是能力的不同层次。一项能力可以已经存在，但仍需要不同条件才能成为稳定输出。

after.en: Life Structure brings the chart’s main mechanics into one view. It considers the carrying conditions of the Day Master, the functional balance of the Ten Gods, candidate pattern paths and the relationships between pillars. The purpose is to understand how the chart organizes support, demand and direction before applying it to specific life domains.

In BaZi, “wealth” is first a structural function. Actual income, assets and financial outcomes still depend on real-world decisions and conditions outside the chart.
after.zh: 财富运势读取的是命盘与资源之间的关系：价值如何被创造、交换、调动、维持，以及怎样进入责任结构。在八字里，“财”首先是一种结构功能；真实收入、资产与财务结果仍取决于命盘之外的现实决定与条件。

after.en: Wealth is read as a resource cycle: how value enters, what must be exchanged for it and what competing demands act on it afterward.
after.zh: 财富要按资源循环来读：价值如何进入、需要交换什么，以及之后有哪些要求会分流资源。

after.en: Resource opportunity and resource retention are different structural questions. Receiving more does not automatically mean keeping more.
after.zh: 资源机会与资源留存是两个不同问题。得到更多，并不自动等于能够留下更多。

before.en: For relationships, the leading functional group is peer and self-position at about 45.5%, carried mainly by Peer, Direct Officer, and Rob Wealth. It does not require one pattern path to stand alone and is modified by interfaces such as environment ↔ self anchor. It directly reconnects to 2 whole-chart priority themes, so this is not an isolated mini-reading.
before.zh: 就「关系」而言，在这个主题里，「同类与自我位置」是当前最靠前的功能组（约 45.5%），主要连接到比肩、正官、劫财。当前不需要依赖单一格局路径，并经过月令环境 ↔ 自我锚点等柱位接口修正。它与整盘 2 个优先主线直接相连，因此不是独立的小结。

after.en: Relationships & Marriage reads how the chart approaches closeness, reciprocity, expectations, responsibility and personal position within important bonds over time. It does not reduce another person to a symbol; instead, it examines the recurring relational functions carried by this chart.
after.zh: 感情婚姻读取的是命盘在重要关系中如何处理亲近、互惠、期待、责任，以及自己的位置。它不会把另一个人压缩成一个符号，而是观察这张命盘反复携带怎样的关系功能。

after.en: Relationship reading begins with your recurring position: expectations, exchange, support, responsibility and boundaries need to be read together.
after.zh: 关系读取先看你反复出现的位置：期待、交换、支持、责任与边界需要一起理解。

after.en: Recorded links and tensions show where interaction may require negotiation. They describe relational structure, not the other person’s hidden motives.
after.zh: 已记录的联结与张力显示哪些互动需要协商；它们描述关系结构，不代表对方的隐藏动机。

after.en: Health & Wellbeing translates the chart’s load, rhythm and support structure into a non-clinical view of daily functioning. It focuses on how pressure, recovery and routine are organized. It does not diagnose disease, identify vulnerable organs or replace medical assessment.
after.zh: 健康养生把命盘中的负荷、节奏与支持结构，转换成对日常运作的非临床观察。重点是压力、恢复与生活规律怎样被组织；本章不诊断疾病、不判断器官弱点，也不能代替医疗评估。

after.en: Pressure is a structural theme before it is a health theme. It may describe demand, accountability or sustained load without implying illness.
after.zh: 压力首先是结构主题，其次才是生活观察主题。它可以代表要求、责任或持续负荷，但不等于疾病。

after.en: Recovery conditions matter as much as demand. Sleep, routine, workload, environment and practical support belong to real-life wellbeing evidence and should remain visible.
after.zh: 恢复条件与负荷同样重要。睡眠、作息、工作量、环境与实际支持，都属于真实生活中的身心证据，需要被保留下来。
